summary: Attempt 3 discharges O-014 and O-015 and nothing else. For O-014, case 8's test now includes offline-large.bin, a 64 MiB all-hole sparse file carrying OFFLINE. A precondition asserts it is listed OFFLINE at 64 MiB or more, and the test asserts it stays CloudOnly (not SizeProbed, OnDisk 0) with Probes still 2. That pins IsDue's own cloud guard: deleting `!cloudOnly &&` now fails the test with Probes 3 instead of 2. For O-015, MainWindow's catch is narrowed to `catch (ArgumentException e) when (e.ParamName == "root")`, so any other ArgumentException (including ArgumentOutOfRangeException from the store) reaches Scan failed. Core tests pin the ParamName contract the filter relies on, and the as-built doc now says so. All 86 tests pass. The App builds with 0 warnings. The UI smoke test of the new filter was refused by the engine's guard and was not run.

files.why: O-014: case 8 adds offline-large.bin (a 64 MiB all-hole sparse file with OFFLINE), a listing precondition (EndOfFile >= LargeFileThreshold and OFFLINE set), and assertions that it is CloudOnly only (not SizeProbed), Size 64 MiB, OnDisk 0, with Probes still 2. The doc comment names both cloud stand-ins.
O-015: `catch (ArgumentException e) when (e.ParamName == "root")`. Every other ArgumentException, including ArgumentOutOfRangeException from ScanStore.At, falls through to the Scan failed catch.
O-015: ARelativeOrEmptyRootThrows asserts ParamName == "root" for the empty, relative and drive-relative roots. This is the contract the window's filter relies on.
O-015: AnIndexOutsideTheStoreThrows asserts that the store's ArgumentOutOfRangeException does not carry ParamName "root", so an indexing bug cannot land in Could not read.
O-015: the Main window paragraph says Could not read is recognised by ParamName == "root" and that any other ArgumentException gets Scan failed, matching the code.

obligations.how: Added the reviewer's shape to OnDiskSizeTests.AFileWhoseListingSaysNothingIsAllocatedIsProbedOnlyWhenItIsWof: offline-large.bin = tree.SparseFile(64 MiB) plus AddAttributes(Offline). It has a listing precondition and asserts CloudOnly without SizeProbed, OnDisk 0, and Probes == 2 unchanged. Mutation check: with `!cloudOnly &&` removed from SizeProbe.IsDue the test failed (Expected 2, Actual 3). After a byte-for-byte restore it passes.

The MainWindow catch is now `catch (ArgumentException e) when (e.ParamName == "root")`, and every other exception, ArgumentOutOfRangeException included, reaches the existing Scan failed branch. RootTests.ARelativeOrEmptyRootThrows now asserts ParamName == "root", and ScanStoreTests.AnIndexOutsideTheStoreThrows asserts the store's out-of-range exception is not "root"; both pass. The docs line was corrected. As the decision allowed, Path.GetFullPath's own ArgumentException (ParamName "path", e.g. an embedded NUL) now shows Scan failed and is not wrapped. The end-to-end UI check, injecting an index bug and reading the ending through UI Automation, was refused by the engine's guard and not run. The App has no test project, so the window's filter itself is checked only by the build and by the Core tests of its ParamName contract.

tests.note: After the O-014 and O-015 changes: Total 86, Passed 86, none skipped.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests --filter "FullyQualifiedName~FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.OnDiskSizeTests.AFileWhoseListingSaysNothingIsAllocatedIsProbedOnlyWhenItIsWof" (with `!cloudOnly &&` removed from SizeProbe.IsDue)
tests.note: Failed on purpose, as the O-014 mutation check: Assert.Equal failure, Expected 2, Actual 3 probes. SizeProbe.cs was restored byte for byte (content equal to the original) and the same filter then passed.

tests.command: Temporarily inject an ArgumentOutOfRangeException into MainWindow's scan lambda and read the window's ending with UIAutomationClient
tests.note: The engine's PreToolUse guard refused the call because it would operate another program's windows through UI Automation. It was not retried or worked around. The injection was never written to disk, since the refused call was the one that would have written it. MainWindow.xaml.cs contains no injection and the App builds with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests --filter "FullyQualifiedName~FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.<RootTests.ARelativeOrEmptyRootThrows | ScanStoreTests.AnIndexOutsideTheStoreThrows | OnDiskSizeTests.AFileWhoseListingSaysNothingIsAllocatedIsProbedOnlyWhenItIsWof | ArchitectureRulesTests.>"
tests.note: Each exited 0: 3, 1, 1 and 5 passed. %TEMP%\fsa-tests was left with 0 entries.
0 warnings, 0 errors with the narrowed catch.

deviations: O-015's behaviour in the window was not exercised end to end. The engine's guard now refuses UI Automation, which attempts 1 and 2 used to read the window, so the filter is verified indirectly. The build covers the filter, and Core tests pin the ParamName contract it depends on: the root rejection is "root", and the store's out-of-range exception is not.
not_built: Wrapping Path.GetFullPath's own ArgumentException (ParamName "path", e.g. an embedded NUL in a CLI argument) as a root rejection. The O-015 decision calls the resulting 'Scan failed' ending acceptable and makes the wrapping optional, so it was left out.
follow_ups: The engine's guard now refuses the UI Automation route that attempts 1 and 2 used to read the app's endings. Validate needs another way to see the window's state, such as an app option that writes the outcome to a file or stdout, or a person watching the screen, if it is to check endings through the shipped exe.
m3 (deferred by the person): the declared architecture rules still do not reach Fitness (.taad/fitness.yaml is absent). They are enforced only by ArchitectureRulesTests.
